text: 下面进入口袋 04 · 2024–2025 英一新题型首段秒杀卡，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【2024 混合题】如何用两句话合并“公园 406 增至 670”与“健身区点赞”？请盲拼：

As is clearly revealed by the bar chart, the number of city parks surged remarkably from 406 in 2020 to 670 in 2022. Meanwhile, the accompanying picture depicts a citizen smiling in a new fitness area.
手术刀：先用 As is clearly revealed 吞数字，再用 Meanwhile 接入图画。
【2025 纯表格】拒写流水账，请用“最大涨幅空调 + 次要两项 respectively 打包”写出：
Specifically, air conditioners witnessed the sharpest surge from 75.2 to 145.9, while washing machines and refrigerators climbed steadily to 98.2 and 103.4 respectively.
手术刀：sharpest surge 锁极值，其余两项用 climbed steadily 与 respectively 打包。
【点题过渡】用物称动词短语点明消费或民生升级的深意：
These figures vividly reflect the steady upgrading of Chinese residents' living standards.
手术刀：vividly reflect 锁定主题关键词，直接把接力棒交给第二段。
